cost_model.mag_mult_basis: MEASURED 2026-08-09 (m_cellmult wave, box 47025043): per-iteration-per-master-k Cr/Ru = 1.63 at identical NP=20/nk=4/state, x the archive iters-per-step ratio 26.1-28.8 vs 11.9-13.9 = band [3.06, 4.03]; 3.5 retained mid-band
cost_model.mag_mult_caveat: the pre-measurement optimistic end (1.0, from cross-box relaxation timings) is EXCLUDED by the same-box measurement; those timings were contaminated by box sharing.
cost_model.cell_mult_status: MEASURED 2026-08-09 (m_cellmult wave): 20.52/3.95 = 5.19 s/master-k, estimator spread 5.19-5.21. Floor/ceiling are a labelled +/-15% allowance for state dependence (only s0_OH was measured).
cost_model.step_mult_status: ASSUMED. 22 free atoms against 11 and a spliced half-and-half start. The measured 1x1 counts are the floor.
cost_model.rank_speedup_basis: Ir *OOH, identical cell: NP=4/npool=4 3.39 s/kpt/SCF-iteration (probe/Ir/s0_OOH__base) vs NP=20/npool=4 0.669 (probe/Ir_hess/s0_OOH__hess_ref) = 5.07x, but the NP=4 arm was sharing the box. Relaxations NP=4 -> NP=12 give 1.50x for 3x ranks. 3.0 is the conservative end.
cost_model.max_seconds_rule: 2.0x the estimate at the NP the job will run at, floor 7200 s (finding [8](iii))

pending_measurements.status: MEASURED 2026-08-09 -- wave ran on box 47025043, all three legs converged inside the cap (434/212/1818 s). CELL_MULT 5.19 (spread 5.19-5.21), MAG per-iteration 1.63 -> MAG_MULT band [3.06, 4.03], 3.5 retained. Outputs: runs/probe/{Cr,Ru}_cellsym/*__cellmult.out.

gate_c.test: |E(2x1 clean) - 2 E(1x1 clean at the folded mesh)| within tolerance AND total magnetisation within tolerance. Energy alone can be passed by a different magnetic state at near-degeneracy.
gate_c.second_control: s0_O__2x1o_mir is the exact replication of the relaxed 1x1 *O cell and must return 2 x E(1x1 *O at the folded mesh) to the same tolerance

spectator_contingency.test: after ref__2x1o converges, measure the spectator O's |y - y_cus|
spectator_contingency.action: if |dy| exceeds the threshold, a ref__2x1o_mir job is REQUIRED before the interaction term S(2x1o) - S(2x1v) is scored. Adding it after reading the interaction is post-hoc.

cr_magnetic.per: every Cr job, every SCF iteration (pw.x prints it free)
cr_magnetic.pair_action: a mir/off pair that disagrees by more than the tolerance is CONFOUNDED under docs/43 s5: excluded from every symmetry statistic and reported separately
cr_magnetic.gate1_emitter: build_cellsym_pilot.py --gate1 (wave 2; refuses until every Cr relaxation has `bfgs converged`)

evaluates: docs/43-prereg-week1-factorial.md s1 -- the sign rule on every mir/off pair
docs/43-prereg-week1-factorial.md s2-A.3(a) -- Cr mir/off total and absolute magnetisation, CONFOUNDED above tolerance
docs/43-prereg-week1-factorial.md s2-A.4 -- GATE C and GATE C-2 on energy AND magnetisation
readout.scoreability: hard rule 3: a relax must carry `bfgs converged`, an SCF a final total energy and no `convergence NOT achieved`. `JOB DONE` is never the test. A pair whose halves are not both scoreable is PENDING, never OK.
readout.scorer_selftest: 2026-08-09: the scorer's arithmetic reproduced the two P10 rows then on disk (Ir -0.291323, Ru -0.081714 eV). That is a CODE test, not the replication gate: a gate that re-reads the run it exists to replicate cannot fail (N2). The replication gate (GATE R) scores the FRESH Ir s0_OOH__1x1_off run and is PENDING until that run converges.

sign_rule.action: voids that arm; it is not reported as 'symmetry does not matter here'

scoring_rules: Gate on `bfgs converged`, never on `JOB DONE` (hard rule 3). pw.x prints JOB DONE after convergence NOT achieved, after nstep exhaustion, after a max_seconds stop and after a user .EXIT.

A job that stopped on max_seconds must be REBUILT from its own `Begin final coordinates` and its .out DELETED before requeue: queue_r1.sh SKIPs any job whose .out contains JOB DONE, and a bare requeue would restart from the input geometry and throw the work away.
Cite the measured max|F_y| or the measured |dy|, never the presence of nosym (lessons.md 2026-08-09).
